parent: The root-augmented model changed 5 of 9 focal decisions on the first 81 later questions but scored .511809 versus .513554 with new labels zeroed. All nine are retrospective for this version. Freeze all 128 source forecasts, both possible preceding actions and all long-prefix endpoints before scoring; use no later, independent development or test outcome for fitting. Learn a small decision rule by directly optimizing estimated value, inspired by Zhou, Athey and Wager, Offline Multi-Action Policy Learning (https://doi.org/10.1287/opre.2022.2271). Here paired observed contrasts supply the training targets.
data: 84 previously measured decision comparisons from six training histories: 60 with physically measured cap-corrected raw and verified credit, plus 24 earlier audited decisions with verified credit only. Keep unknown raw missing. Anchor on the checkpoint's native conditional probability at each donor state. Equally weight histories, then source nodes, then measured backgrounds within node for each endpoint. Use disjoint histories to discover and confirm a rule. Neither step ever uses the outer target history.
rules: For each target history and stage, average the ten allocations of three of the other five histories to discovery and two to confirmation. Candidate regions are the whole population, one side of a 25th/50th/75th percentile cut of any of the 12 frozen current-source geometry features, and (terminal only) the actual preceding temporal or activity action. Derive cutpoints on unique discovery sources. A region must cover at least two discovery histories in the objective's observed data. A simple raw-return base changes native probability only in one selected region. An override changes the base in one such region to native, or to a 65% mixture toward activity or temporal. Derive gain directly as probability change times paired F1 or signed verified credit; maximize equal-history mean, breaking ties in favor of no intervention then smaller changed probability mass. Default offers with zero incremental discovery utility to no change. Average probabilities across the ten individual policies, preserving separate mixture mass toward each skill. No future or target QA is required to act.
confirmation: Offer the best incremental verified-credit rule on discovery. Deploy it only if both raw and verified-credit improvements over that split's base are positive on the two untouched confirmation histories. Identical zero credit must reproduce the raw base. Compare the same extra rule selected and confirmed by raw returns alone, same-stratum rotated signed credit, the ungated credit offer, native, terminal, repaired raw-return, matched-use, and earlier consensus. Publish per-fold clearances, support, actual probability changes, paired and design-weighted F1 and exact four-path replicas. A shallow rule may be rejected everywhere. Unmodified probabilities are counted. Use the last physical prior action on a long prefix, or the root rule on an empty prefix.
promotion: Retain all complete 40-window/378-question later and 99-endpoint/185-question prefix gates including independent exact replication and strict-prospective checks. In addition to +.02 over native and terminal, require gains over the raw-only base, extra raw-only rule, rotated credit, repaired raw-return and earlier consensus. Leave the two independent test datasets locked. Report early retrospective results with their exposure counts.
